brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 bases placed: piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full - 2x2 diamond cluster at level 0 as shown in get_build.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: No run remains. Attempts to create a single run through all four cells were refused with ROUTE_NO_PATH ('no legal route') and ROUTE_CELL_OCCUPIED (one run per cell). Valid entryEdge/through combinations tested exhaustively, all refused. Two temporary runs (0,-1→0,0 and 1,-1→1,0) were created but removed trying to join all four. No irrigation riser or PVC-bore bin present.

finish.summary: Build has four cells in a compact 2x2 arrangement. Water pipe coverage failed: the configurator's routing rules prevent a single straight-through pipe from entering one outer cell and traversing the other three in this geometry - every multi-cell through-route returned ROUTE_NO_PATH, and a cell can only hold one run. Check_build is clear (meshClash clear) with only LOOSE_BODY warnings for unbolted pieces.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
